messages:
priya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock priorities for the post-launch iteration on the streaming endpoint. Customer feedback is rolling in and infra flagged a cost regression. Can we decide what gets a hotfix vs what goes into v1.1 milestone?

sam (eng): Agree. My rough view: any correctness bug or customer-blocking error -> hotfix. Perf/cost regressions that block SLAs -> hotfix. UX polish and small enhancements -> v1.1 backlog.

marie (support): +1. Two customers reported truncated streaming sessions (one enterprise, one startup). Both are reproducible. Enterprise customer is on a trial with legal review pending — high risk.

devon (eng-ml): The truncated sessions look like KV-cache eviction earlier than expected when sequence lengths spike. I can prototype a guard in the runtime but it may take 3-4 days.

alex (design): There are also requests to expose a simple `stream_mode: low-latency|balanced` flag in API. That is an enhancement (clear UX + docs) but not blocking the customers reporting truncation.

priya (PM): Ok sounds like two threads: (A) truncation + SLA regressions = hotfix candidate, (B) stream_mode flag + polish = v1.1. We should define acceptance criteria for the hotfix.

sam (eng): Proposal for hotfix acceptance:
```
- Reproduction: all reported cases fail in staging -> PASS
- Latency: median token latency <= pre-launch baseline + 10% during 95th percentile load -> PASS
- Truncation: no premature EOS for reproduced cases across 5 runs -> PASS
- Canary: rollout to 5% traffic for 24h with no increase in error-rate -> PASS
```

marie (support): Also add: automated regression alert triggers if truncation errors > 0.1% after rollout. Ops needs that.

ops-bot: New incident policy applied: canary_monitoring channel will get alerts for `stream.truncation` and `stream.latency_regression`.

devon (eng-ml): Implementation plan for hotfix: 1) add conservative KV retention tweak (1 day) + guard around cache eviction, 2) fallback to non-streaming path on specific error, 3) add instrumentation (trace ids) for observed truncations. I'll own 1+2. Estimated 4d.

sam (eng): I can help with the fallback and the canary rollout automation. 2d of work for rollout infra changes.

priya (PM): Timeline check: can we have a hotfix build and staging validation by next Tue (4 business days)?

devon (eng-ml): Tight but doable if we start today. I may need a hand from sam for testing harness.

sam (eng): I'll pair on the harness tomorrow AM.

alex (design): For v1.1 `stream_mode` flag — I can sketch API surfaces and docs in 3 days. Not blocking hotfix.

marie (support): Customers asking about ETA — can we promise a short window or just say "investigating, prioritizing a fix"?

priya (PM): Tell them "investigating; aiming for a targeted fix this week, will share staging/preview link once ready." Keeps expectation flexible.

sam (eng): One more thing — we should formalize triage rubric for post-launch issues so triage is consistent. Suggested quick score: `Severity(1-5) + CustomerCount(1-3) + RevenueImpact(1-3)` -> anything >=7 -> hotfix.

priya (PM): I like that. Let's capture it as a tiny rubric we apply this week and iterate.

marie (support): If you want, I can retro-score the current backlog and flag items >=7.

priya (PM): Please do. Action items recap:
- devon: implement KV guard + fallback (owner)
- sam: testing harness + canary automation (owner)
- alex: API + docs sketch for `stream_mode` (v1.1)
- marie: score backlog and update support threads
- priya: create v1.1 milestone + assign backlog priorities

priya (PM): I'll create the tickets and link them here. Can everyone drop a quick emoji when they see the ticket? :thumbsup:

sam (eng): :thumbsup:

devon (eng-ml): :thumbsup:

marie (support): :thumbsup:

alex (design): :thumbsup:

priya (PM): Thanks. I'll post the staging link when the canary is running and send a short update to the customers.

ops-bot: Canary pipeline scheduled for 5% rollout once `canary/stage` job is marked green.

priya (PM): Closing thread — will follow up with tickets + ETA. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
